product_name: Salt marsh lamb& mint hand cook crips

full_assessment.summary: This product contains moderate-risk additives (Salt (including British Salt Marsh Lamb Seasoning), Sunflower Oil). Consume in moderation.

moderate_risk.name: Salt (including British Salt Marsh Lamb Seasoning)
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** High sodium intake is linked to hypertension and increased risk of cardiovascular diseases.  The mechanism involves increased blood volume and vascular damage.  Moderation is key; recommended daily intake varies by individual factors. (Source: WHO guidelines on sodium intake).  The "British Salt Marsh Lamb Seasoning" likely contains additional salt, exacerbating this risk.

moderate_risk.name: Sunflower Oil
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** While generally safe,  high consumption of any oil can contribute to weight gain and related health issues.  The type of oil and processing methods (e.g., high heat frying) can influence the formation of potentially harmful compounds like aldehydes. Moderation is advised.

moderate_risk.name: Potatoes
moderate_risk.micro_report: **  Acrylamide, a potential carcinogen, can form in potatoes during high-temperature cooking (frying, baking).  The amount formed depends on cooking temperature and time.  Moderation and varied cooking methods are recommended. (Source: EFSA reports on acrylamide). [1][2]

low_risk.name: Rice Flour
low_risk.micro_report: **  Good source of carbohydrates, generally safe.

low_risk.name: Igar (assuming this is a misspelling of Agar-Agar)
low_risk.micro_report: ** A gelling agent derived from seaweed; generally safe and often used in vegan cuisine.

low_risk.name: Dried Yeast Extract
low_risk.micro_report: **  Source of umami flavor and B vitamins; generally safe.

low_risk.name: Dried Onions
low_risk.micro_report: **  Good source of antioxidants and flavor; generally safe.

low_risk.name: Dried Wine Vinegar
low_risk.micro_report: ** Adds flavor and acidity; generally safe in moderation.
